segments.sn35.78:1.1: “Yo kho, rādha, anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.78:1.3: Cakkhu kho, rādha, anattā. Tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.78:1.4: Rūpā … cakkhuviññāṇaṃ … cakkhusamphasso … yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā … pe … mano anattā … dhammā … manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphasso … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā.
segments.sn35.78:1.13: Yo kho, rādha, anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.

lines: Navopi hi koci paññāto hoti rāhulatthero viya sumanasāmaṇero viya ca, ayaṃ pana navo ceva apaññāto ca.
74-78. Appaññātoti nāmagottato ceva sīlādiguṇehi ca appaññāto avissuto.
